yamlCheck.dateAnchor: November 25 (t08), November 27 (t15–t17), and November 28 (t21) are spoken independently. The year 1748 is from YAML. The preceding evening is November 24 by the first overnight; the closing midnight is November 29 by civil rollover.
yamlCheck.explanation: The return evening, three intervening overnight advances, the next morning after the November 27 dream, and midnight after the November 28 first lift cover November 24–29. The November 27 workday and its retrospective morning/afternoon scries are counted once. The unfinished return-day arithmetic at t15 and the future November 30 travel forecast do not add days. The dated campaign note has a different internal chronology, retained as a review discrepancy rather than used to rewrite these markers.
